title: The Sneak Bypass
story: The conveyor lamp stays on constantly even when the start switch is released! A faulty jumper wire is bypassing the switch. Find and delete the bypass wire.
concept: Sneak circuits: A parallel wire that circumvents a control contact will keep the load energized regardless of switch position. Tap a wire to delete it.

learn.title: Bypass Shorts
learn.text: If a wire jumpers directly from the feed rail around the switch, the switch loses control.

tests.name: Lamp must turn OFF when START is 0

steps.explanation: Lamp must be OFF when switch is released.
Lamp must be ON when switch is pressed.

hints: Notice that Rail L connects to both START and directly to the LAMP.
Tap the bypass wire connecting Rail L straight to the LAMP to delete it.
The only path from L to LAMP should pass through START.
